incidents.name: kTAF liquidation seize rounding
incidents.notes: Repeatedly liquidating tiny slices of an underwater kDAI loan against the low-value kTAF market let liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens round the seized kTAF collateral up each time, so the attacker seized more collateral than the DAI it repaid was worth.

sources.ref: onchain review: kTAF 0xf5140fc35c6f94d02d7466f793feb0216082d7e5 (CErc20Immutable, symbol kTAF) created 2020-07-24T00:02:01Z by 0xa13b3e79f2ed49bc05af2274dc509d73a75cafe2, unrelated to the attack sender; CErc20Immutable has no delegatecall implementation slot and emitted no EIP-1967 events, so age runs from deployment (1182.7 days). Loss ~$8K per the PoC header, realised in DAI.
